dshHome.description: Trial host $DSH_HOME. Default: env DSH_HOME, else DSH_GLOBAL_HOME, else ~/.dsh. Never /home/box or /workspace.

inboxRoot.description: Absolute, or relative to dshHome. Default: supervisor/trial/inbox.

thinStateRoot.description: Absolute, or relative to dshHome. Default: $DSH_TRIAL_THIN_STATE or supervisor/thin-state.

mailboxRoot.description: Absolute, or relative to thinStateRoot. Default: $DSH_TRIAL_MAILBOX or mailbox.

brokerDir.description: Absolute, or relative to dshHome. Default: $TRIAL_BROKER_DIR or broker-dsh-trial.

recentLimit.description: How many recent chain/summary/inbox/mailbox rows trial_status returns.
